title: Enable the worktrees cleanup rule by default on CoderOS and pool hosts
body:
P1.3: both background cleanup rules ship off. Enable the `worktrees` rule (daily, worktree_days 7) by default on CoderOS (`~/coderos-hosts` nix config if needed) and GCE/Boat pool hosts; keep the `disk` rule opt-in on owner Macs. Document.

From the Paseo worktree gap analysis (docs/worktrees/2026-10-03-paseo-worktree-gap-analysis.md, 61580a0aec), phase 1 (disk).
